verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the independently deliverable burgundy block-colour pareo with a black border, defining its rendered artwork colours.
The client supplies a tentative terracotta Pantone reference and confirms that the artwork colour may initially use a visual approximation pending production confirmation.
This is the first target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports developing both block-colour pareo artworks with Slim and Full border-scale choices.
The client confirms that the block-colour artwork should retain the 7 cm and 17 cm border-scale options; no prior value key becomes obsolete.
